children: ICICI Securities's research report on Premier Energies

Premier Energies ramped up steadily in Q2FY27, producing 900MW+ of cells (+81% YoY), and 1.2GW of modules. It recently commissioned a 7GW cell facility, which it expects would reach 70% utilisation by Mar’27. With that, operational capacity now stands at 10.6GW of cells and 11.1GW of modules. The 5GW wafer-ingot facility remains on track for commissioning by FY28. For the quarter, it reported revenue of INR 26bn (+43% YoY), with EBITDA of INR 7.4bn (+31% YoY). However, EBITDA margin contracted 250bps YoY to 28%, which we attribute to a higher share of non-DCR sales hurting the gross spread. It secured INR 42bn in order inflows (OI) during the quarter,

Which lifted its order book (OB) to INR 166bn, executable over 12–14 months. Maintain BUY with an unchanged TP of INR 1,250, basis 25x FY28E earnings. Key risk: Decline in spread due to rising competition.
